title: A System for Ranking Factors Affecting the Effectiveness of Test Management in Innovative IT Projects
content: Effective test management in innovative IT projects is a complex, multifactor process. It is important to identify priority factors that affect test planning, organization, and control while accounting for their interrelationships. This can improve the consistency of management decisions, promote more rational use of resources, and enable testing processes to be adapted to the specific characteristics of innovative projects. This paper proposes a factor-ranking system that combines expert assessment, analysis of inter-dependencies, and the determination of weighting coefficients. The consistency of ex-pert judgments was assessed using Krippendorff’s alpha coefficient. Relationships among the selected factors were represented as a semantic network, which was used to construct a multilevel model of factor priorities. Factor weights were determined using the pairwise-comparison method and multifactor optimization. An information sys-tem was developed to automate calculations and visualize results, thereby supporting evidence-based management decisions.
